bio.text: H. Brooke Paige, a Republican, advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026, and is listed on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for Vermont Secretary of State, according to Ballotpedia.
According to Ballotpedia, he earned a B.A. in business administration from the University of Delaware.
Ballotpedia lists his work history as food service manager, sales for a pharmaceutical laboratory, and owner and operator of a newsstand business.
